blocks.text: Ammonia (NH₃) nitrogen ka ek aham industrial compound hai, jo zyada tar fertilizer (khaad) ke taur par istemal hota hai. Industry mein yeh Haber-Bosch process se banaya jata hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: ⇌ ka matlab hai ke reaction reversible hai: NH₃ banti bhi hai aur wapas N₂ aur H₂ mein tootti bhi hai, aur aakhir mein equilibrium qaim ho jata hai. Teer ke oopar Δ ka matlab hai garam karna.

blocks.prompt: Ammonia itne bare paimane par kyun banai jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ka zyada tar hissa fertilizers mein jata hai (khud ammonia, ammonium salts aur urea ki shakal mein). Paudon ko nitrogen chahiye magar woh hawa ki N₂ seedha istemal nahi kar sakte; Haber-Bosch process hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia mein badal deta hai.

items: NH₃: nitrogen ka aham industrial compound, zyada tar fertilizer.
